messages:
Ravi (eng-platform): FYI: we're rotating the CI JWT signing key next month. Old key will be accepted in a grace window for 10 days, then rejected. Migration window: 2026-07-10 -> 2026-07-20. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/ci-jwt-rotation :loudspeaker:
Noelle (security): Will consumers need to fetch new JWKS or just rely on kid header fallback?
Ravi (eng-platform): We publish a new jwks endpoint at /.well-known/jwks.json and support kid-based resolution. Update clients to fetch jwks every 5m or use caching with 1h TTL.
Eve (devex): We'll add a CI lint that verifies JWKS fetch succeeds in the preflight job. Snippet in docs shows using curl + jq to validate.
ci-bot: Reminder: scheduled key rotation job created @ 2026-07-10T02:00:00Z :gear:
Noelle (security): Rollback plan: if verification breaks, we can re-enable the previous key for affected orgs for up to 72 hours. Must create a support ticket and get 2 approvals.
Ravi (eng-platform): Publishing list of impacted services and example client code by EOD tomorrow. Please update any service that validates CI JWTs (buildkite, internal runners, webhook handlers).
Eve (devex): Noted, will add tickets to the monorepo migration board and schedule time to update templates.
Ravi (eng-platform): Thanks. If you see failures after 7/20 open an incident and tag Noelle.
